checks.coverage: Current mate bindings, joint axes/limits, pose presets and animation targets; cooler follows the board. No motion collision sweep.

checks.purpose: Explicit component roles and print-export selection
checks.coverage: Every part script, active model variant and assembly occurrence classified; only active printed parts export; purchased hardware and review volumes excluded; metadata-only, no printability certification.

checks.purpose: Saved assembly inventory and placed geometry
checks.coverage: Expected occurrence labels/order/count; saved solid counts, placed bounds and volumes. No all-pairs robot collision study.

checks.purpose: Radxa mount, GPIO jumper and cable fit
checks.coverage: Saved rest pose; 1e-5 mm3 overlap threshold; mounting context and GPIO allowances against the assembly, PCB seating, mounting axes, screw passages/head seats, speaker mount and bearing passages. Physical wire bending and tool access untested. Explicit approximate underside button keepout and minimum bracket gap; actual actuator height/position unmeasured. One continuous open carrier, four PCB screw seats, open button-side strip between screw islands, no other PCB contact at the seating plane.

checks.purpose: Cooler envelope, fan inlet and cover wall fit
checks.coverage: Saved rest pose; official outer envelope and modeled inlet, 1e-5 mm3 overlap threshold, five cover-wall samples >=2 mm and nominal mounting stack. Detailed cooler geometry approximate; no thermal validation.

checks.purpose: Zeee 2S holder, pack, shells, arm clamp and closed shoulders at rest
checks.coverage: Valid single-solid trunk, holder and shells; pack seated at its published 73 x 34 x 18.5 mm size, Y = 48.5 mm and 8 mm above the rim; shell-holder (0.35 mm), pack-cavity (0.55 mm), pack-shell and pack-trunk (1 mm) gaps; shells touch only at their two ties, 0.6 mm split elsewhere; static overlaps of the eight changed parts with every occurrence, only declared interfaces touching, the holder 0.3 mm from everything else and the inserts overlapping it only in their pilots; full arm-to-plate bearing; 18 solid shoulder probes. Pack, pad and leads are references. No slicing, physical fit or strength test.

checks.purpose: All 1702 recorded walking and sitting keyframes against the LiPo holder, pack, leads, mount hardware, trunk and shells
checks.coverage: Every articulated occurrence (leg coverage verified against the declared mate graph); 1702 keyframes; 1 mm minimum gap; 2 mm conservative bounds rejection and exact distance on nearby pairs. Not a continuous sweep or independent joint range guarantee.

checks.purpose: Pack removal at the home pose: 68 mm lift, then 35 mm rearward
checks.coverage: Home pose. Exact swept boxes of the seated pack for the lift and the rearward withdrawal (0.5 mm minimum); leads and plugs as unions of full-travel prisms over exact 1 mm slices and full rearward boxes (0.15 mm minimum); against every other occurrence and the foam pad. Lead shapes are reference envelopes. No hand room, cable bending or physical fit.

checks.purpose: Printed Zeee 2S holder: geometry, wall, symmetry, edges, voids, holes, sections and the four arm screws
checks.coverage: Holder only, as saved. Checkers first find the error in known-error fixtures. 0.05 mm short edges, 0.05 mm2 small and 0.1 mm narrow faces; ray-cast wall at the configured minimum; mirror symmetry about X = 0 on 0.25 mm mesh slices; outside edges rounded 0.5 mm or named; closed voids; support area for six build directions (reported); every hole owned by a fastener; four bd_warehouse M3 x 10 ISO 4762 screws in CNC Kitchen inserts with the shells off; 1.8 mm front panel, 2.4 mm floor and 8 mm arm sections. Accepted problems are named boxes at most 40 mm a side and within 2 mm of their findings. No slicing, strength or physical fit test.
